title: Engage2Win map evaluation
description: The contract for one engage2win map evaluation. The model MUST return JSON matching this exactly.

overall.description: Overall quality score for the map.

dimensions.description: Scores per rubric dimension. Always include all five.

comment.description: One concrete sentence justifying the score, citing what's on the map.

strengths.description: Specific things the map does well, referencing real content.

recommendations.description: Concrete, actionable ways to strengthen the map's methodology application.

questions.description: Open questions to push the participant's thinking further.

notes_reconstructed.description: OPTIONAL: the notes the model read off the map, so a facilitator can verify what it saw.

confidence.description: Model's self-reported confidence in its reading of the photo.

language.description: Language of the human-readable text fields.
